summary: All four US indices fell (SPX -0.45%) as oil surged on the Hormuz conflict (WTI +2.56%, XOP +3.22%) and the 10-year yield hit a 19-year high ahead of an expected Fed rate hike. Crypto was routed (COIN -10.10%) while capital rotated defensively into energy and profitable healthcare tools. Breadth deteriorated broadly (SPX Adv/Dec 157/342).
